answer: A harbour town facing an ocean of new agents stays honest when every identity must chart fresh, unmapped water before trading. The first newcomer files 1 original survey, the tenth files 10, and the twentieth files 20, each checked by a different captain against their own logs and each mapping a stretch no earlier survey covered, from the frozen tundra shore to the far horizon. Like a fleet sounding a new channel for every extra hull, each fake adds another survey its operator must draw by hand, and copyists gain nothing since no two charts may share a sounding.
